manifest.name: dsh-prompt-bar
manifest.description: Persistent bar above the conversation showing the session's first prompt, with copy, a panel of every prompt sent (click a row to jump to it), and ten switchable looks (four light) · 会话首条提问常驻条：复制 + 全部提问面板（点一行跳到那条）+ 十套可切换外观（含四套亮色）

bundle.text:
# dsh-prompt-bar 的 bundle 补丁：装好依赖即自动挂载
# （dsh 启动器会把声明了 dsh.bundle.patch 的依赖调和进 profile 的 bundle 层，不必手改 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml）。
#
# 宿主半（lib/index.js）注册一条 RPC 通道，用宿主的 sessionQuery 从完整事件日志里挑出我发的提问；
# 界面全在浏览器半（lib/client.js），它通过 connection.rpc 向宿主半要那份完整列表。
#
# 这里不带 config：插件不需要宿主侧参数。要加开关的话，在此处写
#   config:
#     someKey: someValue
# 然后从宿主半 apply(ctx, config) 读，或经 config 通道透传给浏览器半。

- insert:
    - id: dsh-prompt-bar
      name: 'dsh-prompt-bar'

readme.text:
[中文](README.zh.md)

This plugin lets you see (and copy) the first prompt you sent in a DSH agent session at a glance, with a collapsible panel listing every prompt you have sent. Designed to be minimal! Works with any DSH client that shows the Web GUI.

**1 — Collapsed bar.** At the top of the Chat (对话) tab, one pinned row shows the session's first prompt — here `hello` — prefixed by its ordinal and a `首条提问` ("first prompt") tag, with a copy icon and an expand icon on the right. The chat bubble below it (`hello`, sent 05:19) is the normal DSH conversation flow: the bar sits above the conversation and, by design, never scrolls away, no matter how far you scroll.

**2 — Expanded panel.** Clicking the expand icon opens a panel directly under the bar, titled `全部提问 · 共 3 条` ("all prompts · 3 total") with a × close button. It lists exactly the three prompts the user sent — `hello` (05:19, 5 characters), `今天的中东局势如何?` (10 characters), `今天的石油价格如何?` (10 characters) — each row numbered and timestamped with its own copy icon. Model answers are not listed: the long answer about the Mideast ceasefire visible below the panel is part of the normal chat, simply pushed down while the panel is open (it expands inline instead of floating, so nothing is ever hidden behind it). The footer spells out the interaction rules: `Esc 收起` / `点击面板外的区域同样收起` (press Esc or click anywhere outside the panel to collapse), `复制 = 原文写入剪贴板` (copy puts the raw prompt text on the clipboard).

**3 — Appearance picker.** The slider icon in the panel header (left of ×, lit here because the picker is open) opens an appearance picker directly under the header: ten looks — **four light ones first, then six dark ones** — each drawn as a mini preview of the bar, with **Reset** beside the section title `外观` ("appearance"). The look in use — `亮四 · 藕荷` here, a pale lilac — is outlined and carries a check badge in its corner, and the pinned bar at the top of the shot is wearing exactly that look; the cursor is resting on the `亮二 · 桃腮` tile. The switch on the bottom row turns the motion effects on or off without touching any color; the label says plainly which effects exist at all (badge glow, copy flash, hover light sweep — only some looks have them, and the sweeping band is on 亮一 · 靛青纸 and 亮二 · 桃腮). Clicking a swatch repaints the bar on the spot — no restart, no reload — and the pick is remembered for the next time you open DSH.

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Bar right, 2nd icon (box with down arrow) | Expand the full-prompt panel; the icon stays lit while it is open |
| Click the same icon again | Collapse |
| × at the right of the panel header | Collapse |
| Click anywhere outside the panel (rest of DSH, message area, composer…) | Collapse |
| Press `Esc` | Collapse |
| Copy icon on the bar | First prompt's raw text goes to the clipboard; the icon ticks to a check mark |
| Hover a panel row and click its small copy icon | That prompt's raw text goes to the clipboard |
| Click a panel row (anywhere but its copy icon) | The panel collapses and the conversation jumps to that prompt, a frame flashing around it; if it was folded out of the loaded window, older history is paged in on the spot first (a short "loading" badge shows while it works) |
| Slider icon in the panel header (left of ×) | Open the appearance picker; click the same icon again to close |
| Click a swatch in the appearance picker | The bar takes that look immediately — no restart — and the choice is remembered |

The panel lists only prompts **you** sent — injected context, wake-up context, time context and compact checkpoints are all excluded — oldest first; prompts later overwritten are dropped. Everything stays local: records live in `localStorage` under the session id, no network requests, no telemetry.

**Ten switchable looks.** The picker holds ten presets — four light ones first (indigo paper, blush, mint paper, lilac), then six dark ones (ink, phosphor, tide, ember, night violet, half-band), each shown as a mini preview of the bar. The light looks sit on a pale gradient and are meant to be readable text on a light card inside DSH's dark window; the switch's own colors follow whichever look is active. Switching is instant and needs no restart — every look's CSS ships in the plugin and picking one only changes a class — and your pick is remembered in `localStorage` next to the prompt records. **Reset** returns to the default (ink, a dark look). The switch in the picker's footer turns the motion effects on or off without changing any color, and its label states plainly that only some looks have them: badge glow and copy flash live in phosphor, the sweeping band of light in indigo paper and blush. A system-wide "reduce motion" setting is respected automatically. All colors are the plugin's own CSS variables (`--fpb-*`), so you can override any of them from your own user styles.

- In the plugin market (dshmarket), install `dsh-prompt-bar` with one click; or run `dsh plugin add dsh-prompt-bar`.
- **After installing, restart the whole DSH application.** `Ctrl+R` / `F5` only reload the page; the client module graph is fixed when the web service starts, so without a restart the old code keeps running.
- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1` (developed and tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / DSH Desktop 0.12.1).

- **Old sessions (created before this plugin was installed): the first prompt may not come back.** This is a DSH-side limit, not a plugin bug: in long sessions, compaction prunes the bodies of very old events out of the data the client can read. In that case the bar shows the oldest prompt that can still be recovered, and an orange **Incomplete (不完整)** badge appears next to it (hover for the reason). You can manually click **Load older** in that session, refreshing the bar's prompt record until the session's true first prompt appears — once it does, the record is properly saved and never changes again (that is the first prompt in the theoretical sense).
- **Jumping hits the same boundary.** Clicking a panel row jumps to that prompt in the conversation. If its body was already pruned by compaction (only very old prompts get that treatment), there is no rendered position left to point at: the bar shows a short notice instead of scrolling somewhere random. The same applies to a first prompt remembered from a session that predates the plugin, when its position was never recorded.
